_설명: 천일문 2권 Chapter 11 접속사 Chapter Test 뒷장 가운데 부사절 문항(18·19·21·22번)을 변형한 것. 기본 14과 접속사[1] 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: When the bell rang, I was eating lunch.
If it will snow tomorrow, we will go sledding.
You should not press the button unless it is urgent.
The library stays open until the last student leaves.
Because Mina’s eyes were tired, her dad bought her a lamp.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: Let’s wait here until the rain stops.
I visited the Colosseum when I traveled to Rome.
If you skip breakfast, you will feel tired.
Unless you don’t hurry, you will miss the train.
While Mom cooked dinner, I set the table.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 것끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: ⓐ Don’t go outside if you have a fever.
ⓑ Though the box is very light, I can’t lift it.
ⓒ Unless he apologizes, we won’t forgive him.
ⓓ The shoes were so small that she couldn’t wear them.
ⓔ The baby can’t walk yet because he is so little.
ⓕ The match was canceled because the heavy rain.

questions.prompt: <상황>과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하세요.
body: <상황> 내일 날씨가 맑으면 우리 가족은 소풍을 갈 것이다.
(if / the weather / be / sunny / my family / go)
questions.answer: If the weather is sunny, my family will go
